sql:
SELECT period, vendor_id, sku, unit_price_orig, contract_unit_price, qty, fx_rate, (unit_price_orig - contract_unit_price) * qty * fx_rate AS excess_cad
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line
WHERE period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
AND unit_price_orig > contract_unit_price
ORDER BY period, vendor_id, sku
